Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the CAU recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the Central Agricultural University (CAU) recruitment is Medical Attendant. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Medical Attendant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Medical Attendant post in the Central Agricultural University (CAU) recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for the CAU Medical Attendant post?
faq.answer: The last date to apply, which is also the date of the walk-in interview, is 04 August 2026. Candidates must attend the interview on this date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Medical Attendant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed 10+2 from a recognised Board/Institution and possess a Certificate of paramedical workers training course or Multipurpose Health worker course from a recognised institute.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Medical Attendant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Medical Attendant post is 24 years. Specific age relaxation details are not provided.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Medical Attendant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Medical Attendant post will receive a salary of Rs. 21700 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for the CAU Medical Attendant recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Medical Attendant recruitment at Central Agricultural University.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Medical Attendant role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Medical Attendant role involves Document Verification followed by a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview for CAU Medical Attendant recruitment be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the Central Agricultural University campus in Bermiok, Sikkim, with the pincode 737134.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs. This includes ID proof and educational certificates.
